book.title: The Broken Crown
book.author: Jesse Karjalainen
book.subtitle: A relic unearthed. A truth concealed. A legacy reclaimed.
book.description: When a grieving widower's night-time search across the fields of Wiltshire uncovers a fragment of King Alfred's crown, he becomes entangled in a web of royal secrecy, modern violence, and buried truths that refuse to stay hidden. The Broken Crown weaves contemporary investigation with echoes of England's past, exploring power, loss, and the cost of revelation in a world still shaped by its history.

audienceMatch.title: Audience Connection
audienceMatch.keyCharacteristics: Educated, culturally engaged readers aged 25–65 with strong interest in history, mystery, and investigative storytelling. The Broken Crown appeals strongly to readers who value intelligent, emotionally resonant mysteries grounded in real-world settings. Its dual appeal spans a digitally active 25–54 audience—urban professionals, journalists, and academics—and an older 45–65 readership of heritage enthusiasts and royal-history devotees. Ebook and audiobook consumption dominate, with library memberships and podcast discovery providing sustained reach across global English-speaking markets.

analysisOverview.title: Analysis Overview
analysisOverview.readership: The book attracts globally literate readers who prefer sophisticated thrillers blending personal loss, moral ambiguity, and institutional mystery. Its audience demonstrates high reading frequency, values authenticity over sensationalism, and engages across both digital and traditional discovery paths.
analysisOverview.classification: Positioned as a royal-history mystery with investigative and archaeological threads, The Broken Crown draws from a bespoke subgenre taxonomy encompassing Treasure Hunt, Cold Case Mystery, and Alternate History motifs. It occupies a refined space between literary suspense and commercial thriller, offering a measured, atmospheric take on heritage intrigue.
analysisOverview.personas: Charlotte Hensley, an academic reader attuned to moral complexity and historical fidelity, embodies the book's reflective core, while Daniel Okoro, a journalist hungry for truth and ethical tension, mirrors its investigative heartbeat. Together, they illustrate a readership that craves both intellect and emotional resonance.
analysisOverview.marketingGuidance: The marketing insights in this report provide a foundation for early campaign development—shaping tone, messaging, and visual identity around heritage, secrecy, and redemption. They form the prototype for an expanding marketing intelligence layer that will evolve into a standalone product, integrating creative prompts and data-driven targeting frameworks.

positioning.title: Royal-history mystery with investigative spine
positioning.subtitle: A dual-strand contemporary thriller braided with historically anchored revelations
positioning.description: Primary signals cluster around Treasure Hunt, Archaeological Adventure, Alternate History and Cold Case Mystery, positioning the book as a UK-set quest thriller where a relic discovery collides with state secrecy and a journalist's murder case. The appeal sits between literary-leaning suspense and commercially paced clue-driven mystery, with cross-over potential into historical fiction through time-slip interludes. Readers who enjoy decoding symbols, archive scenes, and ethically charged dilemmas within recognisable British institutions are the core target.

moodAndTone.title: Tense, reflective, and conspiratorial
moodAndTone.subtitle: Subdued melancholy under sustained investigative tension
moodAndTone.description: Mood skews tense and inquisitive with solemn, gothic notes from royal chapels and vaults. Tone balances reflective grief and methodical clue-work with occasional bursts of violence. The overall atmosphere is dusky, archival and ceremonial rather than pulpy; intrigue and ethical ambiguity drive momentum more than action set-pieces.

brandPositioning.uniqueValueProposition: A present-day royal-vault mystery where an Anglo-Saxon fragment unlocks a lineage secret while a journalist's femicide investigation converges on the same trail.
brandPositioning.targetReaderIdentity: Adults who favour UK-set clue fiction with archival research, ceremonial settings and morally complex institutions.
brandPositioning.emotionalAppeal: Redemption from grief, the allure of hidden history, and the ethical weight of truth versus protection.
brandPositioning.marketDifferentiation: Less puzzle-gloss and more sober authenticity: English locales, verisimilar protocol, and a credible media/legal thread broaden beyond standard symbol-thrillers.

opportunities.rationale: Plenty of palace-adjacent cosies and high-octane capers exist; few deliver sober procedural realism inside royal archives and vaults.

marketing.title: Crown and Consequence: Marketing Strategy for The Broken Crown
marketing.subtitle: Positioning a dual-timeline historical mystery for contemporary readers
marketing.objective: To establish The Broken Crown as a premium literary thriller that bridges royal intrigue and modern true-crime fascination, appealing to mature, globally literate readers seeking emotional depth and historical resonance.
marketing.keyInsight: Readers are drawn to narratives that expose the intersection of private grief and institutional secrecy, particularly when tied to authentic heritage and journalistic truth-seeking.
howToUse: Deploy across owned, earned, and paid media channels to ensure consistent brand voice.
Integrate content themes—history, secrecy, and justice—across visuals and copy.
Time creative bursts to coincide with royal anniversaries or heritage events.
Use influencer outreach to historians, book clubs, and literary podcasts for earned media.
Monitor engagement sentiment to refine tone from intrigue to emotional depth.
primaryKPIs: Return on ad spend (ROAS) of 3:1 or higher

funnels.name: Awareness
funnels.description: Introduce the novel through striking imagery and narrative hooks evoking royal mystery and hidden lineage.
funnels.formats: Short video teasers, carousel ads, podcast sponsorships, organic social posts.
funnels.optimisation: Test creative with variations of mystery versus emotional appeal; prioritise high retention metrics.

funnels.name: Consideration
funnels.description: Deepen engagement with readers through historical context and author storytelling.
funnels.formats: Blog essays, YouTube shorts, newsletter interviews, influencer reviews.
funnels.optimisation: Leverage dwell time and engagement signals to remarket to active readers.

funnels.name: Conversion
funnels.description: Drive purchases via emotional CTAs and limited-time offers tied to heritage themes.
funnels.formats: Amazon A+ copy, BookBub ads, direct email campaigns, paid social retargeting.
funnels.optimisation: Automate high-performing ad sets and A/B test cover imagery and CTA language.
